Package com.sharetea.dao

package com.sharetea.dao
Data access objects that run every SQL query and update the app uses, one class per area.
  • Related Packages
    Package
    Description
    com.sharetea
    Application entry point for the Sharetea POS and inventory management system.
    com.sharetea.config
    Database connection settings, read from db.properties and environment variables.
    com.sharetea.db
    The shared database connection, with the offline SQLite fallback and its CSV data loader.
    com.sharetea.models
    Plain data classes for employees, menu items, inventory items and cart lines.
    com.sharetea.ui
    Top-level windows (lock screen, cashier view, manager view) and the shared visual theme.
    com.sharetea.util
    Small helpers shared across the app, such as the console logger.
  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    EmployeeDAO
    Reads and writes rows in the employee table: signing in with a PIN and adding, editing and removing employees.
    InventoryDAO
    Reads and writes rows in the inventory_item table: listing stock, restocking, and adding, editing and removing ingredients.
    MenuItemDAO
    Reads and writes rows in the menu_item and recipe tables: listing drinks and toppings, and adding, editing and removing menu items.
    MenuItemDAO.RecipeEntry
    One ingredient in a new menu item's recipe: which inventory item it uses and how much of it goes into one drink.
    OrderDAO
    Saves customer orders placed at the cashier screen.
    ReportsDAO
    Runs the read-only queries behind the manager reports: trends, top sellers, inventory status, product usage, the X-Report and the sales report.
    ReportsDAO.HourlySalesActivity
    Sales for one hour of a day, used by the X-Report.
    ReportsDAO.InventoryKpis
    Stock summary counts for the inventory panel.
    ReportsDAO.ItemSalesReport
    One row of the sales report: how one menu item sold in a date range.
    ReportsDAO.PaymentMethodSummary
    Sales for one payment method on a day, used by the X-Report.
    ReportsDAO.ProductUsageItem
    How much of one inventory item was used by orders in a date range.
    ReportsDAO.TopSellingItem
    One row of the top-selling drinks list.
    ReportsDAO.TrendsKpis
    Summary numbers for the trends panel over a date range.
    ReportsDAO.XReportData
    Everything shown on the X-Report for one day: sales totals, sales by hour and sales by payment method.
